blocks.zh: 先進治療藥品製造規範 — 第一部分：範疇、品質系統、人員、廠房設備與文件管理
blocks.en: Manufacture of Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products - Part A: Scope, Quality System, Personnel, Premises, Equipment and Documentation

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ATMP 的定義範疇與 PIC/S Annex 2A 的適用對象，區分 Part A（通則）與 Part B（特定類型）的架構差異
blocks.en: Understand the definition and scope of ATMPs and who PIC/S Annex 2A applies to, and distinguish the structure of Part A (general requirements) from Part B (specific product types)

blocks.zh: 掌握 ATMP 製造中的品質風險管理 (QRM) 框架，包括 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) 的建立邏輯與優先級排序
blocks.en: Master the quality risk management (QRM) framework for ATMP manufacture, including the logic and prioritisation behind building a Contamination Control Strategy (CCS)

blocks.zh: 熟悉廠房設計關鍵決策點：封閉系統分級允許條件、正負壓策略、隔離製造區 (segregated area) 的判斷依據
blocks.en: Know the key facility design decision points: the conditions under which closed systems are allowed a lower grade, pressure cascade strategy, and the criteria for a segregated area

blocks.zh: 掌握 ATMP 特有的文件可追溯性要求（30年保存規則）及稽核風險熱點
blocks.en: Master the ATMP-specific documentation and traceability requirements (the 30-year retention rule) and the audit risk hot spots

blocks.zh: Scope — 範疇
blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: 範疇解析
blocks.en: Scope Analysis

blocks.zh: ATMP 三大類型快速識別
blocks.en: Quick Identification of the Three ATMP Types

blocks.zh: 基因治療產品 (Gene Therapy ATMP)：透過病毒/非病毒載體、mRNA、基因編輯工具引入基因修飾
blocks.en: Gene therapy ATMPs: genetic modification introduced through viral or non-viral vectors, mRNA, or gene-editing tools

blocks.zh: 細胞治療產品 (Somatic Cell Therapy ATMP)：人類細胞（自體/異體）經培養後回輸
blocks.en: Somatic cell therapy ATMPs: human cells (autologous or allogeneic) that are cultured and then administered to the patient

blocks.zh: 組織工程產品 (Tissue Engineered ATMP)：含有工程化細胞或組織，旨在再生/修復/替代組織
blocks.en: Tissue engineered ATMPs: products containing engineered cells or tissues intended to regenerate, repair or replace tissue

blocks.zh: 製造方法決定監管路徑
blocks.en: The Manufacturing Method Determines the Regulatory Pathway

blocks.zh: ATMP 的特殊之處在於「製造方法」本身就是產品定義的核心。CAR-T 的「從病人取血 → 病毒轉導 → 回輸」這個製程，決定了它必須遵循什麼法規。
blocks.en: What is special about an ATMP is that the manufacturing method itself is central to the product definition. The CAR-T process of "collect blood from the patient, transduce with a viral vector, infuse back" determines which regulations apply.

blocks.zh: CDMO 接案時第一個問題應是：「這個產品的製造方法讓它落在哪個 ATMP 分類？」分類決定法規義務。
blocks.en: The first question a CDMO should ask when taking on a project is: "Which ATMP category does this product's manufacturing method place it in?" The classification determines the regulatory obligations.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍重要邊界
blocks.en: Important Boundaries of Applicability

blocks.zh: Annex 2A 同時適用於：臨床試驗用 ATMP（investigational）和上市後商業 ATMP（market-authorised）。在國家法規允許下，也可延伸至醫院自製和慈悲用藥場景。台灣 CDMO 為全球藥廠代工時，需確認適用 PIC/S 會員國的具體國家法規解讀。
blocks.en: Annex 2A applies to both investigational ATMPs (clinical trials) and market-authorised commercial ATMPs. Where national legislation permits, it may also extend to hospital-prepared products and compassionate use. When a Taiwan CDMO manufactures for global pharma companies, it must confirm how the relevant PIC/S member country's national legislation interprets the requirements.

blocks.zh: Application of This Annex — 本附錄的適用方式
blocks.en: Application of This Annex

blocks.zh: 適用邏輯解析
blocks.en: Analysis of the Application Logic

blocks.zh: 法規層次優先順序
blocks.en: Hierarchy of Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: 當 Annex 2A 對 ATMP 有特定規定時，優先於 PIC/S GMP Part I / Part II 的一般要求。但如有充分科學依據（以 QRM 原則支持並有文件記錄），可允許偏離。這給了 CDMO 合理的彈性空間，但代價是需要強健的風險評估文件。
blocks.en: Where Annex 2A sets specific requirements for ATMPs, they take precedence over the general requirements of PIC/S GMP Part I / Part II. Deviation is allowed where there is sound scientific justification (supported by QRM principles and documented). This gives a CDMO reasonable flexibility, but the price is robust risk assessment documentation.

blocks.zh: 起始原料的雙重法規義務
blocks.en: Dual Regulatory Obligations for Starting Materials

blocks.zh: ATMP 起始原料（特別是人類組織/細胞、血液成分）除 GMP 外，還受捐贈、採購、測試等人體組織法規管轄。台灣 CDMO 如果涉及使用從海外引進的人類細胞，需確認進口許可及台灣《人體器官移植條例》相關規範。
blocks.en: ATMP starting materials (especially human tissues/cells and blood components) are governed not only by GMP but also by human tissue legislation covering donation, procurement and testing. A Taiwan CDMO that uses human cells imported from overseas must confirm the import permits and the relevant provisions of Taiwan's Human Organ Transplant Act.

blocks.zh: GMP 與生物安全的雙軌合規
blocks.en: Dual-Track Compliance: GMP and Biosafety

blocks.zh: 處理基因改造生物體（GMO）時，必須同時滿足 GMP 要求和生物安全等級（Biological Safety Level, BSL）要求。這兩者可能在某些設計上產生衝突（例如負壓艙對無菌保障的影響），Annex 2A 的 Section 3.7 對此有具體規定。
blocks.en: When handling genetically modified organisms (GMOs), both GMP requirements and Biological Safety Level (BSL) requirements must be met. The two can conflict in some design aspects (for example, the effect of a negative-pressure suite on sterility assurance); Section 3.7 of Annex 2A addresses this specifically.

blocks.zh: CDMO 決策點
blocks.en: CDMO Decision Point

blocks.zh: 接受 ATMP 委託製造前，合規評估清單應包含：(1) 確認產品分類 (2) 識別國家層級的起始原料法規義務 (3) 確認廠區現有 BSL 等級是否足夠 (4) 在 CTA/MA 文件中充分說明 GMP 適用策略。
blocks.en: Before accepting an ATMP contract manufacturing project, the compliance assessment checklist should include: (1) confirm the product classification; (2) identify national-level obligations for starting materials; (3) confirm that the site's existing BSL level is sufficient; (4) explain the GMP application strategy adequately in the CTA/MA dossier.

blocks.zh: Table 1 — 適用範疇示意表
blocks.en: Table 1 - Illustration of Scope of Application

blocks.zh: Table 1 決策解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the Table 1 Decisions

blocks.zh: GMP 強度「由早到晚遞增」原則
blocks.en: The Principle of Increasing GMP Stringency from Early to Late Steps

blocks.zh: 製程越接近最終產品，GMP 要求越嚴格。早期步驟（如細菌庫建立、質體製造）可適用「GMP 原則」而非完整 GMP；最終充填步驟則必須完全合規。這對 CDMO 的質量體系範圍界定（QMS scope）有直接影響。
blocks.en: The closer a process step is to the final product, the stricter the GMP requirements. Early steps (such as bacterial bank establishment and plasmid manufacture) may follow "GMP principles" rather than full GMP, whereas the final filling step must be fully compliant. This directly affects how a CDMO defines the scope of its quality management system (QMS scope).

blocks.zh: CAR-T 製程實例對應
blocks.en: Mapping a CAR-T Process

blocks.zh: 以 autologous CAR-T 為例：(1) 病患細胞採集 → 不在 GMP 範疇但需 traceability；(2) 病毒載體製造 → Full Annex 2A；(3) 轉導 + 擴增 → Full Annex 2A（Grade A/B）；(4) 充填冷凍 → Full Annex 2A + Annex 1。台灣 CDMO 若只承接載體製造，仍須完整適用本附錄。
blocks.en: Taking autologous CAR-T as an example: (1) patient cell collection: outside the scope of GMP but traceability is required; (2) viral vector manufacture: full Annex 2A; (3) transduction and expansion: full Annex 2A (Grade A/B); (4) filling and freezing: full Annex 2A plus Annex 1. A Taiwan CDMO that only manufactures the vector must still apply this Annex in full.

blocks.zh: MCB / WCB 建立的特殊地位
blocks.en: The Special Status of MCB / WCB Establishment

blocks.zh: 主細胞庫 (Master Cell Bank, MCB) 和工作細胞庫 (Working Cell Bank, WCB) 的建立，在多數 ATMP 類型中屬於「原則適用」階段（即輕量 GMP）。但一旦 MCB 品質存疑，整個下游製程的品質保障都會動搖。CDMO 應將 MCB 建立視為高風險活動並加以強化管控。
blocks.en: For most ATMP types, establishing the Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) falls in the "principles apply" stage (that is, lighter GMP). But once the quality of the MCB is in doubt, quality assurance for the entire downstream process is undermined. A CDMO should treat MCB establishment as a high-risk activity and strengthen its controls.

blocks.zh: CDMO 範圍界定練習
blocks.en: CDMO Scoping Exercise

blocks.zh: 若台灣 CDMO 接受委託製造 in vivo 腺相關病毒 (AAV) 載體：從質體 DNA 構建 → MCB 建立 → 病毒載體製造純化 → 充填。請對應 Table 1 確認哪些步驟需要完整符合 Annex 2A，哪些可採原則適用，並在合約技術協議 (Technical Agreement) 中明確界定。
blocks.en: Suppose a Taiwan CDMO is contracted to manufacture an in vivo adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector: plasmid DNA construction, MCB establishment, viral vector manufacture and purification, then filling. Map these against Table 1 to confirm which steps must fully comply with Annex 2A and which may apply the principles only, and define this clearly in the Technical Agreement.

blocks.zh: Principle — 製造原則
blocks.en: Principle

blocks.zh: ATMP 製造核心挑戰
blocks.en: Core Challenges of ATMP Manufacture

blocks.zh: ATMP 與傳統小分子的根本差異
blocks.en: Fundamental Differences Between ATMPs and Conventional Small Molecules

blocks.zh: 傳統小分子藥品：原料藥結構明確，可用多種分析方法表徵，最終可滅菌。
blocks.en: Conventional small-molecule drugs: the active substance has a well-defined structure, can be characterised by many analytical methods, and the product can be terminally sterilised.

blocks.zh: ATMP：(1) 活細胞是「活的工廠」，培養條件同時適合雜菌生長；(2) 許多 ATMP 無法最終滅菌，必須無菌製造；(3) 起始原料（病患細胞）的生物學變異性無法被製程完全消除，這是 ATMP QC 最大的挑戰。
blocks.en: ATMPs: (1) living cells are a "living factory", and the culture conditions also suit the growth of contaminating microorganisms; (2) many ATMPs cannot be terminally sterilised and must be manufactured aseptically; (3) the biological variability of the starting material (the patient's cells) cannot be fully eliminated by the process, which is the biggest QC challenge for ATMPs.

blocks.zh: IPC 的特殊地位
blocks.en: The Special Role of IPCs

blocks.zh: 傳統藥品中，製程中控制 (IPC) 是輔助工具；ATMP 中，IPC 往往是唯一能及時干預的手段。因為最終放行測試可能在產品交付前才能完成（特別是自體 ATMPs）。CDMO 必須在 IPC 設計上投入更多資源，而非依賴最終測試把關。
blocks.en: In conventional drug manufacture, in-process controls (IPCs) are a supporting tool; in ATMPs, IPCs are often the only means of timely intervention, because final release testing may only be completed just before the product is delivered (especially for autologous ATMPs). A CDMO must invest more resources in IPC design rather than relying on final testing as the gatekeeper.

blocks.zh: 工程控制優先於程序控制
blocks.en: Engineering Controls Take Priority over Procedural Controls

blocks.zh: Annex 2A 強調「engineering and technical controls」——這意味著設計封閉系統、隔離器、適當的廠房氣流設計，比依賴人員操作規程更重要。這對 CDMO 資本支出決策有重要意義：投資硬體設施通常比訓練人員程序更能降低長期風險。
blocks.en: Annex 2A emphasises "engineering and technical controls", which means that designing closed systems, isolators and appropriate facility airflow matters more than relying on operating procedures for personnel. This has real implications for CDMO capital expenditure decisions: investing in hardware usually reduces long-term risk more than training staff on procedures.

blocks.zh: ATMP 污染風險公式
blocks.en: ATMP Contamination Risk Formula

blocks.zh:
污染風險 = f(培養條件暴露時間 × 開放面積 × 操作複雜度)
                                 ÷ (工程控制強度 × 人員訓練水準)
blocks.en:
Contamination risk = f(exposure time of culture conditions × open area × operational complexity)
                                 ÷ (strength of engineering controls × level of personnel training)

blocks.zh: 降低風險的首要策略是縮短分子，即縮短暴露時間、縮小開放面積，並增強工程控制。
blocks.en: The primary strategy for reducing risk is to shrink the numerator, that is, shorten exposure time, reduce open area, and strengthen engineering controls.

blocks.zh: Chapter 1 — Pharmaceutical Quality System (品質管理系統)
blocks.en: Chapter 1 - Pharmaceutical Quality System

blocks.zh: 品質管理系統重點
blocks.en: Key Points of the Quality System

blocks.zh: 授權放行人 (Authorised Person) 的 ATMP 特殊義務
blocks.en: Special ATMP Obligations of the Authorised Person

blocks.zh: 傳統藥品的 QP（歐洲）/ AP（台灣）放行是基於批次記錄和規格符合性。ATMP 增加了兩個特殊場景：
blocks.en: In conventional drug manufacture, QP (Europe) / AP (Taiwan) release is based on batch records and conformance to specifications. ATMPs add two special scenarios:

blocks.zh: 兩步驟放行 (two-step release)：如 autologous CAR-T，在交付醫院時還需要補充最終品質確認
blocks.en: Two-step release: for example, with autologous CAR-T, an additional final quality confirmation is needed at delivery to the hospital

blocks.zh: 不符規格緊急放行：當病患無其他治療選項時，不符規格產品也可能在 Competent Authority 批准下例外供應——這是 ATMP 獨有的人道主義彈性
blocks.en: Emergency release of out-of-specification product: where the patient has no other treatment option, an out-of-specification product may in exception be supplied with Competent Authority approval. This is a humanitarian flexibility unique to ATMPs

blocks.zh: QRM 在 ATMP 生命週期的全程應用
blocks.en: QRM Applied Across the Whole ATMP Lifecycle

blocks.zh: 1.2 條明確要求 QRM 從臨床試驗製造貫穿至商業化、技術轉移直至產品停產。這意味著 CDMO 在承接技術轉移時，不能只接收 SOP，還需接收原研發廠的完整風險評估記錄，並在新製造地重新驗證風險控制措施的有效性。
blocks.en: Clause 1.2 explicitly requires QRM to run from clinical trial manufacture through commercialisation and technology transfer up to product discontinuation. This means that when a CDMO takes on a technology transfer, it cannot receive only SOPs; it must also receive the originator's complete risk assessment records and re-verify the effectiveness of the risk controls at the new manufacturing site.

blocks.zh: 生物製程的固有變異性管理
blocks.en: Managing the Inherent Variability of Biological Processes

blocks.zh: 「biological processes may display inherent variability」——這句話的實踐意義是：ATMP 的 Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs) 和 Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) 設定必須容納合理的生物學變異範圍，而不是像小分子那樣追求極窄公差。CDMO 的製程驗證策略需要相應調整。
blocks.en: "Biological processes may display inherent variability": in practice, this means that the Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs) and Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) for an ATMP must be set to accommodate a reasonable range of biological variability, rather than pursuing very narrow tolerances as with small molecules. A CDMO's process validation strategy needs to be adjusted accordingly.

blocks.zh: Chapter 2 — Personnel (人員)
blocks.en: Chapter 2 - Personnel

blocks.zh: ATMP 人員管理特點
blocks.en: Characteristics of ATMP Personnel Management

blocks.zh: 雙向保護概念
blocks.en: The Concept of Two-Way Protection

blocks.zh: ATMP 人員管理是雙向的：
blocks.en: Personnel management for ATMPs works in both directions:

blocks.zh: 保護產品免於人員污染：人員健康狀態（如病毒感染）可能污染細胞培養基
blocks.en: Protecting the product from personnel contamination: the health status of personnel (for example, viral infection) may contaminate the cell culture medium

blocks.zh: 保護人員免於產品危害：病毒載體、基因改造生物體對人員構成潛在生物安全風險
blocks.en: Protecting personnel from product hazards: viral vectors and genetically modified organisms pose potential biosafety risks to personnel

blocks.zh: 這在傳統無菌製造中不存在——操作工作站人員通常只需保護產品，不需要特別的自身生物防護。
blocks.en: This does not arise in conventional aseptic manufacture, where operators at the workstation generally only need to protect the product and need no special protection for themselves.

blocks.zh: 人員流動是污染控制的關鍵變數
blocks.en: Personnel Flow Is a Key Variable in Contamination Control

blocks.zh: 2.3 條的核心要求：接觸「活微生物、GMO、毒素、動物」的人員，不得直接進入其他產品區域。這在多產品 CDMO 廠房中是高風險設計點。如果人員動線不可避免地交叉，必須有基於 QRM 的 CCS（污染控制策略）文件支撐。
blocks.en: The core requirement of clause 2.3: personnel who handle live microorganisms, GMOs, toxins or animals must not enter areas where other products are handled. In a multi-product CDMO facility this is a high-risk design point. If personnel flows inevitably cross, a QRM-based CCS (contamination control strategy) document must support the arrangement.

blocks.zh: 實務設計建議
blocks.en: Practical Design Recommendations

blocks.zh: 多產品 ATMP CDMO 的人員管理最佳實務：(1) 在平面設計時就規劃單向動線；(2) 建立「區域專屬人員」制度，避免人員在高風險區與低風險區之間流動；(3) 在 OH&S 計畫中納入定期血清學監測（如涉及特定病毒載體）。
blocks.en: Best practice for personnel management in a multi-product ATMP CDMO: (1) plan one-way personnel flow at the layout design stage; (2) establish an "area-dedicated personnel" system so that staff do not move between high-risk and low-risk areas; (3) include periodic serological monitoring in the OH&S programme (for example, where specific viral vectors are involved).

blocks.zh: 稽核常見查核點
blocks.en: Common Audit Check Points

blocks.zh: 稽核員在人員章節通常查核：培訓記錄是否涵蓋 ATMP 特定安全措施？健康監測頻率是否與風險等級相符？更衣程序是否區分不同產品區域？人員動線圖是否與 CCS 文件一致？
blocks.en: In the personnel chapter, auditors typically check: Do training records cover ATMP-specific safety measures? Is the health monitoring frequency commensurate with the risk level? Do gowning procedures differ between product areas? Is the personnel flow diagram consistent with the CCS document?

blocks.zh: Chapter 3 — Premises: Production Areas (廠房：生產區域)
blocks.en: Chapter 3 - Premises: Production Areas

blocks.zh: 廠房設計核心決策
blocks.en: Core Decisions in Facility Design

blocks.zh: 隔離層級決策框架
blocks.en: Decision Framework for Segregation Level

blocks.zh: 廠房隔離要求由風險等級決定，由低到高：
blocks.en: Facility segregation requirements are determined by risk level, from low to high:

blocks.zh: Level 1：操作/技術控制即可（如 closed isolators 共用空間）
blocks.en: Level 1: operational/technical controls are sufficient (for example, closed isolators sharing a space)

blocks.zh: Level 2：需要 segregated production area（隔離生產區）
blocks.en: Level 2: a segregated production area is required

blocks.zh: Level 3：需要 dedicated facility（專用廠房）
blocks.en: Level 3: a dedicated facility is required

blocks.zh: 判斷依據：QRM 結果 + CCS 文件 + 國家法規要求。
blocks.en: Basis for the decision: QRM outcome + CCS document + national legal requirements.

blocks.zh: 3.2(b) 的病毒載體同區生產紅線
blocks.en: The Red Line in 3.2(b) on Viral Vectors in the Same Area

blocks.zh: 多種病毒載體同區同時生產時，100% 新鮮風（無循環）是硬性要求，這對 HVAC 系統是重大設計挑戰。台灣 CDMO 如計劃在同一廠房處理多種病毒（如 AAV、慢病毒），必須在建廠初期就規劃獨立的排氣系統，而非後期改造。
blocks.en: When multiple viral vectors are produced simultaneously in the same area, 100% fresh air (no recirculation) is a hard requirement, which is a major HVAC design challenge. A Taiwan CDMO that plans to handle several viruses (for example, AAV and lentivirus) in one building must plan a separate exhaust system at the start of construction rather than retrofit it later.

blocks.zh: 3.4 的絕對禁止：複製型載體的同時儲存/孵育
blocks.en: The Absolute Prohibition in 3.4: Simultaneous Storage/Incubation of Replication Competent Vectors

blocks.zh: 「replication competent vectors」（有複製能力的載體）與其他物料不得同時孵育或儲存，這是無條件禁止（"not acceptable"），沒有 QRM 豁免空間。設計儲存系統時必須確保物理隔離。
blocks.en: "Replication competent vectors" must not be incubated or stored at the same time as other materials. This is an unconditional prohibition ("not acceptable") with no room for a QRM exemption. Storage systems must be designed to ensure physical segregation.

blocks.zh: 生物安全 vs. 無菌保障的矛盾
blocks.en: The Tension Between Biosafety and Sterility Assurance

blocks.zh: 3.3 條提醒：生物安全（保護人員和環境）和產品品質（無菌保障）有時會相互衝突。例如，為了生物安全使用負壓艙，可能影響潔淨室的正壓維持。這個矛盾必須在 CCS 中明確處理，不能只顧其一。
blocks.en: Clause 3.3 reminds us that biosafety (protecting personnel and the environment) and product quality (sterility assurance) can sometimes conflict. For example, using a negative-pressure suite for biosafety may affect the maintenance of positive pressure in the cleanroom. This conflict must be addressed explicitly in the CCS; one cannot be considered at the expense of the other.

blocks.zh: Chapter 3 — Premises: Environmental Control & Air Classification (環境控制與潔淨度分級)
blocks.en: Chapter 3 - Premises: Environmental Control & Air Classification

blocks.zh: 環境控制策略解析
blocks.en: Analysis of the Environmental Control Strategy

blocks.zh: ATMP 潔淨度分級決策樹
blocks.en: Decision Tree for ATMP Cleanroom Grade

blocks.zh: 開放製程（open process）：無後續微生物滅活步驟
blocks.en: Open process: no subsequent microbial inactivation step

blocks.zh: 無菌操作 → Grade A + Grade B 背景（與 Annex 1 一致）
blocks.en: Aseptic operations: Grade A with a Grade B background (consistent with Annex 1)

blocks.zh: 例外：無其他治療選項的威脅生命疾病 → 可向主管機關申請豁免
blocks.en: Exception: for life-threatening diseases with no other treatment option, an exemption may be requested from the competent authority

blocks.zh: 封閉製程（closed process）：QRM 評估決定
blocks.en: Closed process: determined by QRM assessment

blocks.zh: 封閉但定期開啟 → Grade C 可接受
blocks.en: Closed but periodically opened: Grade C may be acceptable

blocks.zh: 全程保持密封完整性 → Grade D 可能可接受
blocks.en: Seal integrity maintained throughout: Grade D may be acceptable

blocks.zh: 3.8 短效期 ATMP 的過濾器風險
blocks.en: 3.8 Filter Risk for Short Shelf-Life ATMPs

blocks.zh: 這是 ATMP 特有的難題：autologous CAR-T 等產品可能在無菌測試結果出爐前就已注射給病患。此時，「通氣過濾器是否完整」變成唯一可在放行前確認的間接無菌指標。CCS 必須包含此項風險的緩解措施，例如：每批次前後均進行完整性測試、強化操作員訓練、設定更嚴格的壓差監測閾值。
blocks.en: This is a difficulty specific to ATMPs: products such as autologous CAR-T may be administered to the patient before the sterility test result is available. In that case, "whether the vent filter is intact" becomes the only indirect indicator of sterility that can be confirmed before release. The CCS must include mitigation measures for this risk, for example: integrity testing before and after every batch, reinforced operator training, and stricter differential pressure monitoring thresholds.

blocks.zh: 3.9 廢水處理是監管稽查熱點
blocks.en: 3.9 Effluent Treatment Is an Inspection Hot Spot

blocks.zh: 生物危害廢水（如含病毒的培養廢液）的排放系統設計，必須同時滿足 GMP 和環境保護法規。台灣若設立 ATMP CDMO，需提前諮詢環保署和農委會關於 GMO 廢水的特殊排放標準。
blocks.en: The discharge system design for biohazardous effluent (for example, virus-containing culture waste) must satisfy both GMP and environmental protection legislation. A Taiwan ATMP CDMO should consult the Environmental Protection Administration and the Council of Agriculture in advance about the special discharge standards for GMO effluent.

blocks.zh: 3.14 「院區製造」的合規架構
blocks.en: 3.14 Compliance Framework for "Manufacture at the Hospital"

blocks.zh: 某些 ATMP（特別是個人化療法）可能需要在醫院手術室完成最後一個製造步驟（如細胞回輸前的最終準備）。此時設備雖在醫院，但必須：(1) 主管機關事先批准；(2) 製造商與醫院之間有書面技術協議；(3) 在醫院中的操作維持驗證狀態。這對 CDMO 的品質合約管理能力是重大挑戰。
blocks.en: Some ATMPs (especially personalised therapies) may require the final manufacturing step to be completed in a hospital operating theatre (for example, final preparation before cell infusion). Although the equipment is then in the hospital, the following are required: (1) prior approval by the competent authority; (2) a written technical agreement between the manufacturer and the hospital; (3) the operations at the hospital remain in a validated state. This is a major challenge for a CDMO's quality contract management capability.

blocks.zh: 廠房設計稽查準備要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Facility Design Inspection Readiness

blocks.zh: 稽查員在廠房章節重點查核：(1) 壓差設計圖及連續監測記錄；(2) 單程通風（single pass）的設計依據文件；(3) 封閉系統的完整性驗證記錄；(4) 負壓艙（如使用）如何確保無菌保障不被影響；(5) 廢水消毒系統的驗證報告。
blocks.en: In the premises chapter, inspectors focus on: (1) pressure differential design drawings and continuous monitoring records; (2) the design rationale document for single-pass airflow; (3) integrity validation records for closed systems; (4) how negative-pressure suites (if used) ensure that sterility assurance is not compromised; (5) validation reports for the effluent decontamination system.

blocks.zh: Chapter 3 — Equipment (設備)
blocks.en: Chapter 3 - Equipment

blocks.zh: 設備管理特殊要求
blocks.en: Special Requirements for Equipment Management

blocks.zh: SUS (Single Use Systems) 的 E&L 評估義務
blocks.en: E&L Assessment Obligations for SUS (Single Use Systems)

blocks.zh: 一次性使用系統 (SUS) 在 ATMP 中極為普遍（生物反應器袋、管路、過濾器），因為它消除了清洗驗證需求並降低交叉污染風險。但 3.15 條要求評估：
blocks.en: Single use systems (SUS) are extremely common in ATMPs (bioreactor bags, tubing, filters) because they eliminate the need for cleaning validation and reduce the risk of cross-contamination. However, clause 3.15 requires an assessment of:

blocks.zh: Extractables（可萃取物）：在溶劑/強烈條件下可能從材料遷移的化學物質
blocks.en: Extractables: chemicals that may migrate from the material under solvent or aggressive conditions

blocks.zh: Leachables（可浸出物）：在實際使用條件下遷移至產品的物質
blocks.en: Leachables: substances that migrate into the product under actual conditions of use

blocks.zh: 不溶性微粒：可能對細胞治療產品造成毒性
blocks.en: Insoluble particles: these may be toxic to cell therapy products

blocks.zh: 3.18 一次性圍阻設備的定期測試義務
blocks.en: 3.18 Obligation for Periodic Testing of Primary Containment Equipment

blocks.zh: Primary containment（初級圍阻）包括手套箱、生物安全艙的密封系統。「定期測試」這個要求意味著需要建立測試頻率的 SOP，並保存記錄作為稽查文件。頻率應基於 QRM 評估，考慮設備使用強度和生物風險等級。
blocks.en: Primary containment includes the sealing systems of glove boxes and biological safety cabinets. The requirement for "periodic testing" means an SOP defining the test frequency must be established and the records retained as audit documentation. The frequency should be based on QRM assessment, taking into account the intensity of equipment use and the biological risk level.

blocks.zh: 3.19 病患基因定序的設備資格
blocks.en: 3.19 Equipment Qualification for Patient Genetic Sequencing

blocks.zh: 個人化 ATMP（如 autologous gene therapy）的製造通常從病患基因定序開始，以決定治療策略。3.19 條要求：這類「支持製造決策的生物資訊分析」設備和軟體也需要驗證和資格確認，即使這些設備本身不直接接觸藥品。這對 CDMO 的數位系統驗證範疇有重要意義。
blocks.en: Manufacture of personalised ATMPs (such as autologous gene therapy) usually starts with sequencing the patient's genes to determine the treatment strategy. Clause 3.19 requires that the equipment and software for this kind of "bioinformatic analysis supporting manufacturing decisions" also be validated and qualified, even though they do not directly contact the medicinal product. This matters for the scope of a CDMO's computerised system validation.

blocks.zh: 設備稽查準備清單
blocks.en: Equipment Inspection Readiness Checklist

blocks.zh: ATMP 設備稽查關鍵文件：(1) SUS 供應商的 E&L 研究報告（含 AET 評估）；(2) SUS 完整性測試記錄（使用前後）；(3) Primary containment 定期測試記錄；(4) 生物資訊系統的 Annex 11 資格確認文件；(5) 設備移動風險評估記錄（如有）。
blocks.en: Key documents for ATMP equipment inspections: (1) the SUS supplier's E&L study report (including AET assessment); (2) SUS integrity test records (before and after use); (3) periodic test records for primary containment; (4) Annex 11 qualification documents for bioinformatics systems; (5) risk assessment records for equipment movement (if applicable).

blocks.zh: Chapter 4 — Documentation: Specifications & Traceability (文件管理：規格與可追溯性)
blocks.en: Chapter 4 - Documentation: Specifications & Traceability

blocks.zh: 文件管理重點解析
blocks.en: Analysis of Key Documentation Points

blocks.zh: 「一病人一批次」的批次定義革命
blocks.en: The Batch Definition Revolution of "One Patient, One Batch"

blocks.zh: 傳統藥品的批次定義是「同一次製造過程中均一的一批材料」。ATMP 的 4.2 條要求：對於 autologous（自體）和 donor-matched（配對捐贈者）的產品，「那個病人的那次製造就是一個批次」。這從根本上改變了：
blocks.en: For conventional medicines, a batch is defined as "a defined quantity of material that is uniform, produced in one manufacturing process". Clause 4.2 for ATMPs requires that for autologous and donor-matched products, "that patient's manufacturing run is one batch". This fundamentally changes:

blocks.zh: 批次記錄的設計（每個病患一份完整記錄）
blocks.en: Batch record design (a complete record for each patient)

blocks.zh: 批次放行的工作量（批次可能多達每週數十個）
blocks.en: The batch release workload (potentially dozens of batches per week)

blocks.zh: LIMS 系統的設計需求
blocks.en: LIMS system design requirements

blocks.zh: 雙向追溯 (bidirectional tracking) 的系統需求
blocks.en: System Requirements for Bidirectional Tracking

blocks.zh: 4.5 條要求的雙向追溯意味著：
blocks.en: The bidirectional traceability required by clause 4.5 means:

blocks.zh: 正向追溯：從捐贈者 → 製造 → 病患（發現供應鏈問題時追蹤影響範圍）
blocks.en: Forward tracing: from donor to manufacture to patient (to determine the scope of impact when a supply chain problem is found)

blocks.zh: 反向追溯：從病患不良反應 → 回溯製造批次 → 回到捐贈者（不良事件調查）
blocks.en: Backward tracing: from a patient adverse reaction back to the manufacturing batch and on to the donor (adverse event investigation)

blocks.zh: 這要求資料系統在整個製造生命週期中保持完整的資料鏈，且在不良反應發生時能「快速」取用。
blocks.en: This requires the data system to maintain a complete data chain across the whole manufacturing lifecycle, and to make it accessible "quickly" when an adverse reaction occurs.

blocks.zh: 30年保存規則的實務挑戰
blocks.en: Practical Challenges of the 30-Year Retention Rule

blocks.zh: 30年的追溯記錄保存是個系統挑戰：(1) 電子系統的長期資料完整性（軟體升級、格式遷移）；(2) 保存成本；(3) 個人資料保護法（GDPR 等）與強制保存義務的衝突。台灣 CDMO 需在 QMS 中建立專門的長期記錄保存政策，並評估資料主權與法規義務的平衡。
blocks.en: Retaining traceability records for 30 years is a systems challenge: (1) long-term data integrity of electronic systems (software upgrades, format migration); (2) retention costs; (3) conflict between personal data protection law (GDPR, etc.) and the mandatory retention obligation. A Taiwan CDMO needs a dedicated long-term records retention policy in its QMS and must assess the balance between data sovereignty and regulatory obligations.

blocks.zh: 異種移植細胞（xenogeneic cells）的額外義務
blocks.en: Additional Obligations for Xenogeneic Cells

blocks.zh: 使用豬或其他動物細胞作為起始原料時，不只要追蹤人類捐贈者，還要能識別供體動物（donor animal）。這觸及動物福利記錄、SPF（specific pathogen free）農場認證等額外的供應鏈文件需求。
blocks.en: When pig or other animal cells are used as starting material, it is necessary to track not only human donors but also to be able to identify the donor animal. This brings in additional supply chain documentation needs such as animal welfare records and SPF (specific pathogen free) farm certification.

blocks.zh: CDMO 文件系統設計建議
blocks.en: Recommendations for CDMO Document System Design

blocks.zh: 為 ATMP 設計文件管理系統時需考慮：(1) 是否採用電子批次記錄系統（eBR）以應對高批次頻率；(2) 追溯資料庫需能存取個人健康資訊但同時加密保護；(3) 建立 30年資料生命週期管理計畫（包含媒體遷移策略）；(4) 設計系統能在不良反應發生後的 24 小時內提供完整追溯鏈。
blocks.en: When designing a document management system for ATMPs, consider: (1) whether to adopt an electronic batch record (eBR) system to cope with the high batch frequency; (2) the traceability database must be able to access personal health information while protecting it with encryption; (3) establish a 30-year data lifecycle management plan (including a media migration strategy); (4) design the system to provide the complete traceability chain within 24 hours after an adverse reaction occurs.

blocks.zh: Part A 第一部分總結 — Key Takeaways for CDMO Operations
blocks.en: Part A Summary - Key Takeaways for CDMO Operations

blocks.zh: 風險驅動架構：Annex 2A 全篇以 QRM 為核心，廠房分級、人員管理、設備選用、文件要求都基於風險評估，而非固定規則。CDMO 必須建立強健的 QRM 流程，並保存決策依據文件。
blocks.en: Risk-driven architecture: Annex 2A is built around QRM throughout; facility grading, personnel management, equipment selection and documentation requirements are all based on risk assessment rather than fixed rules. A CDMO must establish a robust QRM process and retain the documentation behind its decisions.

blocks.zh: 封閉系統是 ATMP 的關鍵競爭力：3.13 條允許封閉系統在 Grade C 甚至 Grade D 背景下操作，意味著高度自動化的封閉製程可以降低廠房建設成本，同時提高污染控制能力——這是 ATMP CDMO 資本投資的重要考量方向。
blocks.en: Closed systems are a key competitive strength for ATMPs: clause 3.13 allows closed systems to be operated in a Grade C or even Grade D background, which means highly automated closed processes can lower facility construction costs while improving contamination control. This is an important consideration for ATMP CDMO capital investment.

blocks.zh: CCS 文件是稽查核心：污染控制策略 (CCS) 在本文件中多次出現，是連結廠房設計、人員管理、製程控制的中樞文件。台灣 CDMO 應優先建立完整且有科學依據的 CCS。
blocks.en: The CCS document is the core of an inspection: the contamination control strategy (CCS) appears repeatedly in this document and is the central document linking facility design, personnel management and process control. A Taiwan CDMO should prioritise building a complete, scientifically justified CCS.

blocks.zh: 自體產品的批次管理革命：每個病患即為一個批次，要求 QMS 在人力、系統、流程上做好批次量劇增的準備，特別是 AP 放行能量和追溯系統的擴展性。
blocks.en: The batch management revolution for autologous products: each patient is one batch, which requires the QMS to prepare its staffing, systems and processes for a sharp increase in batch volume, especially AP release capacity and the scalability of the traceability system.
